questions.q: Which sensor is the main one for stabilization?
questions.explain: The gyro provides angular rate thousands of times a second; the whole stabilization loop runs on it.

questions.q: Why is the compass mounted on a mast together with the GPS?
options: To keep it away from the field of the power wires
So it picks up GPS satellites better together
So it doesn't get in the way of the props
questions.explain: The compass measures the Earth's magnetic field; current in the power wires creates its own field and distorts the heading.

questions.q: How does F4 differ from F7 when connecting SBUS?
options: F7 can't do SBUS without an adapter
questions.explain: The STM32F4 can't invert a UART input in software, so SBUS only works on it through a hardware inverter on a dedicated pad.

questions.q: Why do you cover the barometer with foam?
questions.explain: Airflow and sunlight distort the pressure. Foam smooths it out, and the baro altitude stops jumping.

options: TX to RX, RX to TX, GND
TX to TX, RX to RX and a common positive
questions.explain: One side's transmitter goes to the other side's receiver. Without a common GND the signal has no reference level.

questions.q: The model in the configurator rotates the wrong way. What do you do?
options: Recalibrate the ESCs and the accelerometer
questions.explain: If the board is mounted rotated, you have to tell the firmware with the orientation parameter.

questions.q: Why doesn't an SBUS receiver work on an arbitrary UART of an F405?
questions.explain: F4 has no software inversion, so you need a port with a hardware inverter; F7/H7 invert any port.

options: CRSF mode over a single wire
questions.explain: A UART emulated on GPIO: up to 115200, loads the CPU; for SmartAudio and non-critical things, not for the receiver.
